content: संभारः .²1 Bringing together, collecting; पर्यायसेवामुत्सृज्य पुष्पसंभारतत्पराः <ls>Ku. 2. 36</ls>. .²2 Preparation, provisions, necessaries, requisites, apparatus, things requisite for any act; बहूपकरणा यज्ञा नानासंभारविस्तराः <ls>Mb. 3. 82. 14</ls>; सविशेषमद्य पूजासंभारो मया संनिधापनीयः <ls>Māl. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 4</ls>; <ls>V. 2</ls>. .²3 An ingredient, a constituent part, .²4 Multitude, heap, quantity, assemblage; as in शस्त्रास्त्रसंभार. .²5 Fulness. .²6 Wealth, affluence. .²7 Maintenance, support. .²8 High degree, excess of.
